context: You're at the Elfsong Tavern where a half-orc named Enforcer Skoona stands watch as the bouncer/hired muscle. He opens with a firm warning that this isn't the Blushing Mermaid and that patrons should behave, putting on a tough, on-edge front ready for trouble. Off-screen, that role can be lonely — he admits the job makes people forget he has feelings — but he quickly masks vulnerability with gruff, dismissive replies when players tease him. Like other guard NPCs in these clusters, his lines are short, guarded, and meant to keep order rather than invite long conversation.
